title: Plain words.
logline: The quokka writes its trip plan and every line quietly becomes what it means.

story.setup: At the morning desk the quokka writes in plain Markdown.
story.turn: Each line blooms as it's typed: tasks tick, a choice picks, a switch flips, a table fills, a Mermaid fence draws the ferry route.
story.payoff: Aa → Raw markdown: it was plain text the whole time.

features.claim: Hybrid Markdown shows raw syntax only on the line you are editing.
Lists, checkboxes, choices, switches, tables, wikilinks, and Mermaid diagrams render in place.
Tasks, choices, tables, diagrams, and math draw themselves as you type, and every one of them is plain text.
Aa → Raw markdown switches views in place.
